detail.longDescription: I tested Meta’s Muse Agent the way I actually work: VoiceOver setup, Gmail, real agent tasks, and even an iCloud connector experiment. I like Muse a lot. That’s why the friction matters: chat navigation, text editing, status feedback, notifications, and persistent custom connectors still need work. Full review: https:// taylorarndt.substack.com/p/i-t ried-metas-muse-agent-i-really # Accessibility # VoiceOver # AI # AIAgents
